blocks.text: Theme: Ultra-elite techno-knights, wielding perfected prototypes and unstable experimental systems.

blocks.text: Playstyle: Tiny armies (1–3 units), but each frame is devastatingly strong.

heading: 🛰️ FACTION IDENTITY

heading: 🛰️ FACTION IDENTITY
blocks.text: Weaknesses: Outnumbered, no expendables, punished by swarms.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: When building your army, you may choose to assign no Order, or pick one Order for your entire force.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: If you choose an Order:

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: All Order-specific units in your list must belong to that chosen Order.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Every unit with that Order keyword gains the Order’s trait.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: You may include general New Avalon units as normal, but these units do not benefit from the Order trait.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: You cannot mix multiple Orders in the same list.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: If you do not choose an Order:

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Your force is treated as a general New Avalon detachment.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: You may take general units as normal, but you do not gain any Order trait.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text:
⚔️ Black Knights – The Iron Blade
 Relic Might++: Stationary = +1 ME & AP +1. In melee duels, reroll all failed hits.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text:
🛡️ Argent Aegis – The Shield Eternal
 Guardian Protocols++: Intercept unlimited hits within 10 cm. Once/game, sacrifice 2 STR to keep an ally alive at 1 STR.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text:
🎯 Luminous Lance – The Spear of Heaven
 Piercing Judgment++: Ranged ignores cover & halves Defence from systems. Once/game, one “Judgment Shot” = FP +1, AP +1, reroll all misses.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text:
🕵️ Silver Veil – The Phantom’s Oath
 Veil Phase++: Cancel first two hits on each unit. Once/game, a Veilblade may become untargetable until next activation.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: ⚔️ RECOMMENDED UNIT ROLES

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Knight-Errant – Agile melee skirmisher (duel bonuses, some ranged capability)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Black Knight – Heavy frontline duelist (Cleave, tanky, brutal when stationary)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Veilblade Operative – Stealth assassin (phase evasion, flank killer)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Lancer-Archon – Precision sniper (beam lance, duel target hunting)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Aegis Castellan – Defensive tank (intercepts damage, aura defense)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Seraphim Exemplar – Commander duelist (buff auras, blade mastery)

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: 🎯 TACTICAL GUIDANCE

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Focus on synergy: Keep command units near duelists to maximize buffs.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Avoid being swarmed: Most units shine in 1v1 engagements.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Use orders intentionally: Pick the right Order trait for each unit’s role.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Don’t overbuild ranged: New Avalon’s strength is in the blade.

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: 🗡️ SAMPLE STRATEGY

heading: 🛡️ Knightly Orders (Optional Subfactions)
blocks.text: Pair a Knight-Errant with an Aegis Castellan — the Castellan protects with Guardian Protocols while the Errant flanks. Position a Lancer-Archon to duel the enemy’s ace from range while a Seraphim Exemplar radiates buffs to all frontline knights. Use Veilblades to strike at key targets or grab objectives with stealth and speed.
